summary: The run fixes its technical account (RunSynchronizationUseCase.cs:86) before it takes observedAt (:472); an account change saved in between gives sightings later than the change for a list read as the old account, so a later loss is marked "not in Classroom" instead of "not visible" (BR-049). Address at DB_DESIGN/IMPLEMENTATION or accept.
The digest does not say that a connection saved before the update has no account-change instant (spec FR-002.3), so courses lost then get "not in Classroom".

note: Owner accepted at HUMAN_SPEC_APPROVAL ("m-2 принято"): no pilot school changed its technical account before the update; the digest stays as is.

summary: WorkspaceConnection.ChangeTo gains a DateTimeOffset parameter (one call site, SaveWorkspaceConnectionUseCase); tests calling it are adapted at TEST_WRITING.
Rule R1 moves the run's observedAt before the connection read; existing tests that pin the order of clock reads, if any, are adapted at TEST_WRITING.

note: db-design §6: observedAt taken before the run reads the connection (R1); the change instant read at the end of the list (R2) — a mid-run change can only give the safe 'not visible'.
